reason: A is the better, though still imperfect, proposal because it gives a simpler and more causally testable processing–microstructure pathway, whereas B’s cryogenic/warm hybrid rolling and back-stress concept substantially overlaps the cited hybrid-rolling work and adds poorly justified phases. Both overstate likely processing-induced gains in Young’s modulus, but B’s stiffness mechanism based on strain gradients is especially unsound because back stress raises flow strength rather than intrinsic elastic modulus.
